maria_cs: Hey team — customer on enterprise plan reporting 403 on embeddings only after creating a service token via our CLI yesterday. Gen + rerank work fine. They say the token shows scopes 'inference, rerank' but no 'embeddings'.

elena_support: Customer attached a minimal repro. They ran our CLI: `rdw auth create --name svc-monthly-batcher --scopes inference,rerank,embeddings --format json` and response metadata in our UI/keys API returns scopes without embeddings.

sam_engineer: Can you paste the exact CLI version + platform? also the keys API response body (redact token)

maria_cs: CLI v2.1.5 on Mac, customer pasted this output: 
```
POST /internal/provisioner/v2/keys 200
request body: {"name":"svc-monthly-batcher","scopes":["inference","rerank","embeddings"]}
response body: {"id":"k_abc123","scopes":"inference rerank"}
```
They said UI shows the same.

john_infra: :thinking_face: That response shape is suspicious — scopes returned as a space-separated string. Prov-v2 recently had a change to normalize scopes into a single string for legacy services. I think trailing/third items get trimmed when we join by space and then later parse expecting commas.

sam_engineer: If the DB stores scopes as a space-joined string then the downstream authorizer might be splitting on comma and missing the last token. Could be a serialization mismatch between the CLI JSON -> provisioner -> key-manifest.

maria_cs: Customer verified tokens created via Console (UI) include embeddings properly. Only CLI-created ones hit this. Very reproducible for them.

anna_prod: tagging eng-infra and eng-ml. @john_infra can you triage? Severity: P2 (enterprise customer blocked for batch embeddings pipeline).

john_infra: I can repro locally with v2.1.5 of CLI. Quick repro steps: 
1) `rdw auth create --name t1 --scopes inference,rerank,embeddings --format json`
2) hit /internal/provisioner/v2/keys show stored `scopes` column as `inference rerank`

I traced it to provisioner-v2 handler in key_service.go where we do `strings.Join(scopes, " ")` then later `strings.Split(dbScopes, ",")`. Oops.

sam_engineer: Nice catch. Minimal fix: change join to `,` or change parse to split on space OR better: persist as JSON array in the DB. But that might be bigger. For hotfix: change join to comma and add migration for any existing token rows where DB string contains spaces but not commas.

elena_support: Customer wants a workaround until patched. They asked if we can re-issue the token server-side.

john_infra: Workaround: run our admin API to update scopes: `curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://internal.api.redwood/key/k_abc123" -d '{"scopes":"inference,rerank,embeddings"}'`
That will restore embeddings immediately. I can run this for the customer if CS approves.

maria_cs: Please proceed, they gave approval. I filed ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-14218 (CS: cli-provisioner-scope-serialization).

anna_prod: @john_infra can you post a PR with the change and a short migration script? target mid-day rollout tomorrow if tests pass. Include unit test for CSV <-> array conversions.

john_infra: On it. PR coming soon. I'll also add a temporary detector to log any created keys where scopes string has no comma but contains a space (to catch existing bad rows).

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: infra/provisioner-v2 -> staging. Job #4421

sam_engineer: After patch, let's run a small smoke repro: create 5 tokens with various ordering of scopes, then call the authorizer for embeddings and rerank. If green, roll to prod with one-hour bake.

maria_cs: Customer confirmed workaround applied and embeddings requests now succeed. They appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:

anna_prod: Thanks everyone. Let's follow up in the ticket with root cause, mitigation, and customer note.

john_infra: FYI I'll backfill any tokens created in the last 7 days that match the pattern and email CS the list.

maria_cs: Closing loop with customer once migration done.

sam_engineer: Nice team flow.

elena_support: adding logs from customer that showed `authz: denied - missing: embeddings` before fix; post-fix they show 200 for embeddings calls.

maria_cs: Ending thread; will update the Jira and add customer follow-up template.
